You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0066.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
names=['G','Q','P','O','N','M','R','S','T','U','V','X','A','B','H','F','E','D']
bonds=[('G','Q'),('Q','P'),('P','O'),('O','N'),('N','M'),('M','G'),('R','S'),('S','T'),('T','U'),('U','V'),('V','R'),('P','R'),('O','X'),('X','V'),('N','U'),('M','T'),('A','B'),('B','H'),('H','F'),('F','E'),('E','D'),('D','A'),('G','H'),('G','F')]
# image positions; positive z faces viewer, positive y is upwards
sketch={'G':(532,568,0),'Q':(298,555,0),'P':(210,735,0),'O':(273,928,0),'N':(505,965,0),'M':(635,780,0),'R':(106,727,-1.3),'S':(354,637,-1.3),'T':(487,846,-1.3),'U':(327,1033,-1.3),'V':(123,974,-1.3),'X':(98,1144,0),'A':(190,120,-0.9),'B':(438,118,-0.9),'H':(561,317,-0.9),'F':(681,422,0.7),'E':(565,225,0.7),'D':(340,235,0.7)}
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for n in names:
    a=Chem.Atom('C')
    if n=='Q':
        a.SetNoImplicit(True)
        a.SetNumRadicalElectrons(2)
    rw.AddAtom(a)
for n1,n2 in bonds: rw.AddBond(names.index(n1),names.index(n2),Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
c=Chem.Conformer(len(names))
for i,n in enumerate(names):
    x,y,z=sketch[n]; c.SetAtomPosition(i,((x-400)*0.006,(700-y)*0.006,z))
m.AddConformer(c)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('Formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),'SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms(): print(names[a.GetIdx()],a.GetDegree(),a.GetNumImplicitHs(),a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
print('FF',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m),AllChem.UFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m),'N',m.GetNumAtoms())
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'initial.mol')
# choose universal force field for divalent carbene
ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
ff.Initialize()
print('initial energy',ff.CalcEnergy())
print('status',ff.Minimize(maxIts=5000),'final',ff.CalcEnergy())
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'optimized.mol')
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'answer.xyz')
PY

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('optimized.mol',removeHs=False)
initial=Chem.MolFromMolFile('initial.mol',removeHs=False)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(initial,replaceExistingTags=True); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(initial,force=True,cleanIt=True)
p=m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
print('SMILES optimized',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('SMILES initial',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(initial)))
for i in range(18):
    a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i); b=initial.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
    if a.GetChiralTag()!=b.GetChiralTag(): print('CHIRAL CHANGED',i,b.GetChiralTag(),a.GetChiralTag())
for bond in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=bond.GetBeginAtomIdx(),bond.GetEndAtomIdx()
 if i<18 and j<18: print(i,j,np.linalg.norm(p[i]-p[j]))
# align optimized to initial heavy atoms
q=initial.GetConformer().GetPositions()[:18]; q-=q.mean(0)
p-=p[:18].mean(0)
u,s,v=np.linalg.svd(p[:18].T@q); rot=u@np.diag([1,1,np.linalg.det(u@v)])@v; p=p@rot
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(9,11)); ax=fig.add_subplot(111)
labels=['G','Q','P','O','N','M','R','S','T','U','V','X','A','B','H','F','E','D']
for b in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
 if i<18 and j<18: ax.plot(p[[i,j],0],p[[i,j],1],color='black',lw=2+max(0,(p[i,2]+p[j,2])*1.0))
for i in range(18):
 ax.scatter(p[i,0],p[i,1],s=140,color='C0'); ax.text(p[i,0],p[i,1],labels[i],color='red',fontsize=14)
ax.set_aspect('equal');fig.savefig('optimized.png')

cat > sample.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('initial.mol',removeHs=False)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
sm=Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m))
print('target',sm)
m.RemoveAllConformers()
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=20266;p.numThreads=0;p.useRandomCoords=True;p.pruneRmsThresh=0.15
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=40,params=p)
print('embedded',len(ids))
res=AllChem.UFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=0,maxIters=3000)
candidates=[]
for idx,(status,en) in enumerate(res):
 t=Chem.Mol(m); conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetConformer(idx));t.RemoveAllConformers();t.AddConformer(conf)
 Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(t,replaceExistingTags=True);Chem.AssignStereochemistry(t,cleanIt=True,force=True)
 sm2=Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(t))
 print(idx,status,round(en,3),sm2==sm)
 if sm2==sm:candidates.append((en,idx))
if candidates:
 en,idx=min(candidates);out=Chem.Mol(m);conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetConformer(idx));out.RemoveAllConformers();out.AddConformer(conf)
 Chem.MolToMolFile(out,'optimized.mol');Chem.MolToXYZFile(out,'answer.xyz')
 print('Chosen',idx,en)
else: raise RuntimeError('no stereo-compatible conformer')
